segments.an5.170:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
segments.an5.170:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā bhaddaji yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.an5.170:1.3: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ bhaddajiṃ āyasmā ānando etadavoca –
segments.an5.170:1.4: “kiṃ nu kho, āvuso bhaddaji, dassanānaṃ aggaṃ, kiṃ savanānaṃ aggaṃ, kiṃ sukhānaṃ aggaṃ, kiṃ saññānaṃ aggaṃ, kiṃ bhavānaṃ aggan”ti?
segments.an5.170:2.1: “Atthāvuso, brahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī, yo taṃ brahmānaṃ passati, idaṃ dassanānaṃ aggaṃ.
segments.an5.170:2.2: Atthāvuso, ābhassarā nāma devā sukhena abhisannā parisannā.
segments.an5.170:2.5: Yo taṃ saddaṃ suṇāti, idaṃ savanānaṃ aggaṃ.
segments.an5.170:2.7: Te santaṃyeva tusitā sukhaṃ paṭivedenti, idaṃ sukhānaṃ aggaṃ.
segments.an5.170:2.8: Atthāvuso, ākiñcaññāyatanūpagā devā, idaṃ saññānaṃ aggaṃ.
segments.an5.170:2.9: Atthāvuso, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagā devā, idaṃ bhavānaṃ aggan”ti.
segments.an5.170:2.10: “Sameti kho idaṃ āyasmato bhaddajissa, yadidaṃ bahunā janenā”ti?
segments.an5.170:3.3: “Tenahāvuso bhaddaji, suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.an5.170:3.4: “Evamāvuso”ti kho āyasmā bhaddaji āyasmato ānandassa paccassosi.
segments.an5.170:4.1: “Yathā passato kho, āvuso, anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, idaṃ dassanānaṃ aggaṃ.
segments.an5.170:4.2: Yathā suṇato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, idaṃ savanānaṃ aggaṃ.
segments.an5.170:4.3: Yathā sukhitassa anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, idaṃ sukhānaṃ aggaṃ.
segments.an5.170:4.4: Yathā saññissa anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, idaṃ saññānaṃ aggaṃ.
segments.an5.170:4.5: Yathā bhūtassa anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, idaṃ bhavānaṃ aggan”ti.

lines: Yathā passatoti iṭṭhārammaṇaṃ vā hotu aniṭṭhārammaṇaṃ vā, yenākārena taṃ passantassa.
Anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hotīti anantarāyeva arahattaṃ uppajjati.
Atha vā yaṃ cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nirantarameva vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇāti, taṃ tassa arahattaṃ cakkhuviññāṇānantaraṃ nāma hoti.
Anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hotīti samanantarameva arahattaṃ uppajjati.
Idaṃ sukhānaṃ agganti idaṃ maggasukhaṃ sukhānaṃ uttamaṃ.
Yathā bhūtassāti yasmiṃ bhave yasmiṃ attabhāve ṭhitassa.
idaṃ bhavānaṃ agganti ayaṃ pacchimo attabhāvo bhavānaṃ aggaṃ nāma.
Atha vā yathā bhūtassāti yehi khandhehi maggakkhaṇe bhūtassa vijjamānassa.
Anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hotīti maggānantarameva phalaṃ uppajjati.
Idaṃ bhavānaṃ agganti idaṃ maggakkhaṇe khandhapañcakaṃ bhavānaṃ aggaṃ nāmāti.
Yasmā pana so “pāsaṃsabhāvena uttamabhāvena ca te satte abhibhavitvā ṭhito”ti attānaṃ maññati, tasmā vuttaṃ “jeṭṭhako”ti.
Aññadatthu dasoti dassane antarāyābhāvavacanena ñeyyavisesapariggāhikabhāvena ca anāvaraṇadassāvitaṃ paṭijānātīti āha “sabbaṃ passatīti adhippāyo”ti.
